an4.139:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco dhammakathiko appañ ca bhāsati asahitañ ca,

an4.139:1.5: Evarūpo bhikkhave dhammakathiko, evarūpāyaṃ parisāyaṃ dhammakathiko t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. 2.

an4.139:2.3: Evarūpo bhikkhave dhammakathiko, evarūpāyaṃ parisāyaṃ dhammakathiko t' eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. 3.
